doctrine: ads8: five spec ads (grok, zai, moonshot, claude, claudecode), ads7 grammar: absurd open, plain model, visual quirk never narrated, mouths closed, centre-square composition, guard verbatim
guard: Natural skin texture with visible pores and slight imperfections, documentary realism, no beauty smoothing, imperfect practical lighting, real micro-expressions, natural motion timing with small human hesitations. No readable on-screen text anywhere in frame, no logos, no brand marks. Keep hands either fully out of frame or large, simple and clearly articulated. NO narration, NO voiceover, NO captions, NO avatar or presenter, no music, natural ambient sound only. One single continuous live-action scene, about 5 seconds, subject centered, raw b-roll for an edit. Composed for a centered square crop: every story object stays inside the middle third of the frame and never approaches the left or right edge.

grok.positioning: xAI's general assistant with real-time search and native tool use, on web and mobile, where news breaks first (verified: x.ai, docs.x.ai, 2026-08-29 pairwise pass)
grok.quirk: a pigeon on the bench freezes mid-head-bob when everything around it freezes, one foot still lifted
grok.narration: The whole street changes its mind three times before your coffee cools. Grok is the assistant that watches the world in real time, from the place where news breaks first. Ask it while it's still happening.
grok.closer: Grok, real-time answers with the sources still warm. Ask it while it's happening. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.

scenes.a: Within the first second, every display and newspaper around {character} starts flipping in unison, faster and faster, pages lifting off the newsstand and fluttering upward like startled birds. All lettering is illegible word-mush, no logos. The camera eases back to reveal a pigeon hopping onto the bench beside {character}, bobbing. The street beyond is empty. Keep both inside the middle third, face clear. Hold the framing for the final half second. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.b: Lock camera; keep {character}'s face sharp, frontal and no smaller. Within the first half second the lit advertising panel on the shelter's left wall switches off to plain dark glass with no picture, and every sign and screen turns plain grey: no pictures, text or logos anywhere. The newspapers stay exactly where they lie on the bench and the ground; only their print fades to grey. Pigeon hops beside his thigh, both inside middle third. At 0.6s everything freezes: page aloft, pigeon mid-bob, one foot lifted. Only {character} moves, rising vertically facing camera. End standing before his seat. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.c: Keep inherited framing locked. Only {character} moves, lowering straight onto the bench by 1.2s, facing camera throughout, face sharp and no smaller than when seated before. Hands settle on thighs. Everything else stays absolutely frozen: page beside shoulder, pigeon beside thigh mid-bob with one foot lifted. Both stay inside middle third. All surfaces remain blank; street empty. Hold seated pose to end. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.d: Keep inherited seated framing locked, {character}'s face frontal, sharp and no smaller; pigeon beside thigh, both inside middle third. At 0.6s the street resumes: pages tumble, displays flip through illegible word-mush without images or logos. The shelter's left panel stays plain dark glass with no picture. Pigeon completes its interrupted bob and plants its lifted foot by 1.2s. {character} stays seated. Posters stay blank, street empty. Continue motion to end. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.

props: the lit newsstand behind the bench
